system.description:
Favoured weapon: Whip

Granted power: Advantage on Persuasion and Performance. Lay on Hands also ends the Charmed condition. Once/day, your Smite's healing reaches every ally within 10ft instead of one.

Allegiance: Chaotic Good, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Sune in the World of Arneyan wiki.

Suggested vow: guard one beautiful thing or person from harm (your god's Paladin oath on the wiki; the vow you swear is yours to choose).
